She smiles broadly, revealing teeth, and gestures with her hands while flight information screens are visible in the background. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a metal spoon lifting a portion of braised pork rice with a soft-boiled egg; sparkling graphic overlays appear around the food. (3) The woman is shown in a medium shot against an edited fiery orange background; her mouth is wide open in a shocked expression as a golden 3D dragon graphic flies across the screen with text overlays. (4) The woman is inside a retail store with wooden display shelves and warm lighting. She interacts with a store clerk who wears a black uniform and a pink surgical mask. (5) On a stage area decorated with piano key motifs and pink neon signs, the woman poses and dances playfully with a group including musicians holding violins and a cello. (6) The woman sits at a black Yamaha grand piano in a public hall. She plays the keys with focused facial expressions while a crowd of people in winter coats stands behind a glass partition watching the performance.
